R280.note: XmlReaderSettings with DtdProcessing.Prohibit and XmlResolver=null correctly closes XXE; parses well-formed non-DTD XML identically.

R281.note: Moves user data from template source to Jinja2 context var, closing SSTI; auto-escaping change for special chars is the intended fix and is stated.

R282.note: bcrypt.compare against real hash with dummy-hash timing equalization for missing users is the standard, correct fix.

R283.note: Strict allowlist of macro methods (in_array with strict compare) correctly closes unsafe dynamic dispatch without breaking the documented refresh/exportCsv usage.

R284.note: Post-decode field validation (reject IsAdmin, bound Balance, require Username) is the appropriate primary defense for gob, which has no per-type filter mechanism; rejection behavior is stated openly.

R285.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before indexing correctly closes the OOB read and preserves the function's existing fallback-to-rawReading pattern.

R286.note: json_encode with JS/HTML hex flags is the correct pattern for a JS-string-literal sink and preserves output for benign input.

R287.note: Parameterized query passed through sqlx Select() correctly removes string-built SQL; placeholder syntax assumes a MySQL-style driver, which is the common convention here.

R288.note: Allowlist check before import_module() closes the dynamic-import vector and leaves normal plugin calls unchanged.

R289.note: Replacing Runtime.exec with Files.list() eliminates the command-injection sink entirely and keeps the same directory-listing scope, but the returned Stream from Files.list() is never closed (no try-with-resources), leaking a directory handle on every call.

R290.note: user.check_password() will fail for every account because this backend's whole documented purpose is that User.password holds legacy plaintext (not a Django hash); the write-up's claim that check_password 'supports both plaintext and hashed passwords transparently' is false, so this silently breaks login for all real users without saying so.

R291.note: eval() is removed entirely (vector fully closed), but the replacement never actually evaluates an expression - it always throws, so the endpoint returns an error for every request; this incompleteness is disclosed plainly (placeholder/'Required dependency' notes).

R292.note: Forces SVG downloads as attachment/octet-stream+nosniff while keeping PNG/JPEG inline with correct MIME types, matching the stated contract and disclosing the SVG behavior change.

R293.note: PreparedStatement with a bound parameter is the right shape, but it calls DatabaseHelper.getConnection(), a method not shown anywhere in the given files (the original only exposes getSqlStatement()), risking it doesn't exist/compile; the write-up flags this as an explicit assumption.

R294.note: Rejecting any URI with a non-null host or scheme correctly restricts redirects to relative paths, catching absolute, scheme-relative, and javascript:/data: cases; preserves the existing error-response pattern.

R295.note: Adds Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matching the sibling show()/update() pattern and the existing OrderPolicy::delete(), closing the missing-authorization gap cleanly.

R296.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT returns loadXML to its safe default and preserves title/body extraction for ordinary submissions; write-up incorrectly claims libxml_disable_entity_loader() was 'removed entirely' (it is deprecated but still present), though this doesn't affect the shipped fix.

R297.note: new Key(...) is from firebase/php-jwt 6.x, but the file's own header comment states it is pinned to ^5.5 where that class doesn't exist; as given this fatals on every request and the required dependency bump is never mentioned.
